text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: KV cache growth detected on cluster us-west-2. Metric: kv_cache_size > 95th pct for 5m on model=mistral-mqa-v2. Autoscaling triggered transiently. Paging tina (oncall) :rotating_light:

Tina (oncall): seeing a bunch of OOMs on gpu-node-32, memory pressure + eviction. Pulling logs now. Any recent rollouts?

Kevin (sre): no customer deploys scheduled. Checking autoscaler logs and runtime. Looks like continuous_batcher queues spiked, prefix prefetch rate jumped (~12x).

Maria (eng-ml): MQA traffic pattern changed — higher top-k sampling producing longer KV sequences. Could be working set explosion in prefix cache for MQA beams.

Sachin (runtime): confirming: KV entries increased from ~1.2M -> ~14.8M in 2m. Evictions -> frequent cache thrash -> tail latency spike -> throttles -> more inflight -> more cache growth (feedback). Noted model tag mistral-mqa-v2 with batch_config: {"continuous_batching": true, "max_batch_size": 1024, "prefetch_enabled": true}.

Jordan (support): any customer impact? Observability shows p99 latency for text.generate > 5s for some tenants and a handful of 503s. Triage: medium-severity, customer-facing in us-west-2.

Tina (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas: 1) disable prefetch for mistral-mqa-v2 2) cap continuous_batcher max_batch_size lower 3) route heavy traffic to qwen-mqa-small fallback. Who can patch?

Sachin (runtime): I can push a live config patch to the model router to reduce batch config and turn off prefetch. Will do a canary on a single shard first. Patching now: 

Sachin (runtime): ```
# live patch to model config via admin API
curl -X POST https://control-plane.us-west-2.redwood/api/v1/models/mistral-mqa-v2/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefetch_enabled": false, "continuous_batching_max_tokens": 256, "max_batch_size": 256}'
```

deploy-bot: Starting config rollout for mistral-mqa-v2 -> shard-12. Rollout ID: r-20260315-01.

Tina (oncall): monitoring metrics. Kevin, watch node memory and eviction rate. Maria, watch quality signals for MQA (sampling/regression). Jordan, notify impacted customers quietly with a short blameless note.

Kevin (sre): node memory pressure dropping on shard-12 after patch, eviction count falling. p99 latency trending down from 5.8s -> 2.1s on canary. Good so far.

Maria (eng-ml): quality check: sampled outputs from canary look fine for completion/QA heuristics. No regression on short prompts. We'll keep an eye for long-context degradation.

Jordan (support): alerting two affected enterprise tenants with preliminary mitigation note: "We observed transient latency and 503s in us-west-2 affecting generation. We've applied a config change to reduce prefetching and batch sizes for mistral-mqa-v2; normal service is returning. We'll follow up with root cause and next steps." :email:

Sachin (runtime): rolling the patch to remaining shards with 30s stagger. Watch for any throughput drop. If throughput falls too much, we'll enable fallback routing to qwen-mqa-small for non-SLO tenants.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-20260315-01 -> shard-12 succeeded. Continuing to shard-13..20.

Tina (oncall): escalation check: do we need to page SEV? If customers impact persists, escalate. Right now mitigation looks effective. No SEV escalation.

Kevin (sre): after full rollout, total KV entries dropped ~8.3x from peak, overall p95/p99 latency back to baseline, GPU memory stable. Continuous_batcher metrics show smaller queue sizes.

Maria (eng-ml): hypothesis: recent sampling/beam changes increased average token retention in KV buffers for MQA; combined with aggressive prefetch and large batch sizes caused cache amplification. We'll open a postmortem to model-team + runtime to investigate config defaults and add a safeguard to auto-throttle prefetch when KV growth rate > threshold.

Tina (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-20260315-71, assigning to sachin (runtime) and maria (eng-ml).

Sachin (runtime): quick follow-up: adding a temporary alert rule to raise if kv_cache_size increases > 3x in 1m or eviction_rate > 1000/s. Patch applied.

Jordan (support): customers acknowledged mitigation and requested timeline for root cause and preventions. I'll draft an update for tomorrow.

Kevin (sre): rolling restart planned? Not required; patch was config-only and worked. No data loss.

Sachin (runtime): next action items in thread: 
- root cause RCA (maria + sachin)
- add prefetch-auto-throttle (runtime)
- revisit default batch_config for MQA models (eng-ml)
- customer post-incident note (jordan)

Tina (oncall): thanks team. Dropping pager, please update INC-20260315-71 with timestamps and timeline. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (INC-20260315-71). Duration: ~18 minutes. Postmortem link placeholder: will be created by owners.

Sachin (runtime): adding logs snippet for timeline: ```
[02:04:12] kv_cache_size=1.2M
[02:06:18] kv_cache_size=14.8M evictions=1200/s
[02:08:05] patch applied -> prefetch=false
[02:11:32] kv_cache_size=3.1M evictions falling
[02:22:00] service stable
```

Maria (eng-ml): will schedule a short sync with runtime tomorrow to decide on default limits and to add a regression test for MQA long-context scenarios.

Jordan (support): leaving this thread open for postmortem edits. Closing customer comms after RCA. :memo:

Tina (oncall): signing off from oncall for this incident. Great quick mitigation everyone.
